vulnerabilities.title: Cross-Chain Message Replay Attack
vulnerabilities.description: Signed cross-chain message digests without destination chainId binding allow replaying packets across EVM networks.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Enforce EIP-712 domain separation with block.chainid and persistent execution nullifiers.

vulnerabilities.title: Uninitialized / Zero-Root Merkle Proof Bypass
vulnerabilities.description: Default storage zero-hash accepted as legitimate Merkle root, allowing forgery of arbitrary cross-chain transfer proofs.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Explicitly reject bytes32(0) in Merkle proof verification logic.

vulnerabilities.title: Duplicate Signer Signature Replay in Bridge Multi-Sig
vulnerabilities.description: Multi-signature verification accepts repeated signatures from the same relayer without checking strictly ascending unique addresses.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Verify require(currentSigner > previousSigner) in all signature aggregation loops.

vulnerabilities.title: Unbacked / Unconstrained Wrapped Token Minting
vulnerabilities.description: Destination chain minting routine can be invoked without verifiable collateral lock proof on the origin chain.
vulnerabilities.mitigation: Enforce multi-party verification and automated rate-limiting circuit breakers.
